market_definition: The dual-cure adhesives market comprises adhesives combining two cure mechanisms, such as UV plus heat, moisture or anaerobic cure, to harden shadowed areas. It measures sales of finished dual-cure formulations for electronics and precision assembly. BY SECONDARY CURE MECHANISM: UV + Heat, UV + Moisture, UV + Anaerobic, Other Dual-Cure. BY CHEMISTRY: Acrylic, Epoxy, Silicone. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Electronics & Displays, Medical Devices, Automotive Sensors & Lighting, Optics & Photonics, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Single-mechanism UV-curable adhesives; heat-cure or moisture-cure adhesives; light-curing dental composites. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
